name: Grip Connect
description: Partner-distribution analytics for Grip Connect — AUM, first-time-investor and repeat-investor growth across ET Money, Paisa Bazaar, Mobikwik and Tata Digital, plus registration-to-KYC funnel, redirection hand-off, and KYC document upload health.
chat_context:
Grip Connect is Grip Invest's partner-distribution channel. Four partner apps embed Grip's investment products: ET Money, Paisa Bazaar, Mobikwik, Tata Digital.

Tables:
- grip_connect__01_north_star: the North Star metrics, in LONG format — one row per (partner, metric). `metric` is one of AUM / FTI / Repeat. `mtd` = month-to-date value, `lmtd` = last-month-to-date (the same window one month prior), `delta_pct` = percentage change MTD vs LMTD. `unit` is 'cr' for AUM (value is in INR crore) or 'count' for FTI/Repeat. AUM = assets under management. FTI = first-time investors (new investors that month). Repeat = repeat investors.
- grip_connect__02_reg_to_kyc: registration-to-KYC funnel, one row per partner, for the week starting `week`. All *_pct columns are percentages: reg_success_pct (registration completed), email_verified_pct, mobile_verified_pct, landed_pan_pct (reached the PAN-entry step), kyc_init_pct (KYC started), ucc_kyc_init_pct (UCC or KYC initiated — UCC is the exchange Unique Client Code).
- grip_connect__03_redirect_handoff: redirection hand-off success, one row per (partner, page). `page` is the destination Grip page (asset-detail, user-kyc, checkout). `redirects` = hand-offs attempted, `landed` = sessions that successfully landed, `rate_pct` = landed/redirects.
- grip_connect__04_kyc_upload: KYC document-upload success, currently ET Money only. One row per doc_type (PAN, Bank cheque). `requests`, `success`, `errors`, `error_rate_pct`.
- grip_connect__05_webhook_delivery: webhook delivery success — placeholder, data not yet wired (status = 'Coming soon').
- grip_connect__06_app_holders: share of invested users who also have the Grip app installed — placeholder, data not yet wired (status = 'Coming soon').

Notes:
- All percentages are already computed and stored as numbers (e.g. 90.50 means 90.5%), not fractions.
- AUM values are in INR crore.
- North Star data is month-to-date as of mid-May 2026; the funnel/hand-off/upload metrics are for the week of 4 May 2026.
- When comparing partners, remember the four partners are ET Money, Paisa Bazaar, Mobikwik, Tata Digital.
- Metrics 5 (webhook delivery) and 6 (app holders) have no real data yet — say so rather than inventing numbers.
